text_snippet: Cervezas 1906 Reserva Especial; Xacobeo 2021; 30 cl
notes: Black terrace table printed 'Xacobeo 2021', the same Estrella Galicia-sponsored furniture as p054. The café's tray and kraft paper are present. Street, planters with grasses, grey chairs, green sign or container at left. Third-party beer branding, low appetite appeal.

subject_es: Licuado verde espumoso en vaso alto con pajita envuelta, y sándwich tostado con bacon, lechuga romana, tomate y una capa blanca (queso o pollo)
subject_en: Foamy green smoothie in a tall glass with a wrapped straw, and a toasted sandwich with bacon, romaine, tomato and a white layer (cheese or chicken)
notes: Overhead on a wooden tray with kraft paper, blue speckled plate, dark wood table. Black bag and a plastic plant intrude at the top edge.

subject_es: Mostrador de mármol con vitrinas: cruasanes, empanadillas, bocadillos de barra, bizcocho bajo campana, tarta de capas con crema, dónuts y campana con bollería; bebidas ChariTea y aloe
subject_en: Marble counter with glass cases: croissants, empanadillas, baguette sandwiches, a loaf cake under a cloche, a layered cream cake, doughnuts and a cloche of pastries; ChariTea and aloe drinks on top
text_snippet: ChariTea; ALOE; labels 'BIZCOCHO…', 'TARTA…', 'ECLAIR Café' (prices illegible)
notes: Good overview of the counter layout. The window shows the chevron brand pattern, with Gran Vía trees outside. Mixed daylight and glare. The layered cake looks like carrot cake. Price tags cannot be read reliably.

subject_es: Media tostada de pan integral con tomate rallado y aceite en bandeja, junto al tique del pedido
subject_en: Half a wholemeal toast with grated tomato and olive oil on a tray, next to the order ticket
text_snippet: 1/2 INTEGRAL; TOPPING TOMATE; CAFE SOLO; COLACAO; CAPUCHINO; VASO DE FRUTA; PEDIDO NUMERO: 11
notes: The ticket carries no prices but confirms product names (1/2 integral, topping tomate, vaso de fruta, agua plástico PET). It also shows a customer first name ('ESTHER') and a date of 11/07. Same visit as p045. 3D-cube tile floor, dark tables. Not suitable for publication.

subject_es: Empanada con semillas de amapola, porción de pizza con tomate, queso gratinado y manchas verdes (¿espinacas o queso azul?) y café solo en vaso, en la terraza bajo los árboles de la Gran Vía
subject_en: Poppy-seed empanada, a pizza slice with tomato, melted cheese and green patches (spinach or blue cheese?) and an espresso in a glass, on the terrace under the Gran Vía trees
text_snippet: Estrella Galicia – Persistencia desde 1906; Xacobeo 2021
notes: Sunny terrace shot with nice light through the plane trees. The fence panels and table are Estrella Galicia-branded, a third-party logo to avoid or crop for a hero image. The back of a person's head at the right edge is incidental. Parked cars behind the fence.

subject_es: Café bombón (espresso sobre leche condensada) en vaso y tres piezas de bollería con virutas de chocolate (napolitanas o cruasán de chocolate) en plato rectangular blanco
subject_en: Café bombón (espresso over condensed milk) in a glass and three chocolate-sprinkled pastries (chocolate napolitanas or croissant) on a white rectangular plate
notes: The interior does not match the current café: varnished honey-wood tables with sage-green legs, light-wood drawer counter instead of marble, black chalkboards and wooden bread racks, a pink orchid. It could be the pre-renovation PanPan with the chalkboards mentioned in the brief, or another bakery, so verify before use. None of the PanPan trays or kraft paper appear. The chalkboard text is illegible.

subject_es: Vitrina con empanadillas de ternera, pollo y espinacas, hamburguesas de brioche con sésamo, jamón, queso y lechuga, y bocadillo de barra con carne y verdes; tartaleta en la esquina
subject_en: Display with beef, chicken and spinach empanadillas, sesame brioche buns with ham, cheese and lettuce, and a baguette sandwich with meat and greens; a tartlet in the corner
text_snippet: EMPANADILLA Ternera 2,10€; EMPANADILLA Pollo 2,10€; EMPANADILLA Espinacas 1,95€
notes: Prices are clearly legible. Glossy empanadillas; the spinach ones have a poppy-seed mark. Kitchen behind the glass: coffee grinder, sink, white tiles. Pine boards. Some glare at top.

subject_es: Porción de bizcocho o coca amarillo-verdosa (sabor no identificable, quizá la coca de calabaza de p058) con dos cafés con leche en vaso, agua con limón y botellas
subject_en: Slice of yellow-green sponge or coca (flavour not identifiable, perhaps the pumpkin coca of p058) with two cafés con leche in glasses, water with lemon and bottles
notes: White table, two wooden trays, patterned plate. 3D-cube tile floor and white and brown chairs. The torso of a person in a floral top is visible, face not in frame. Blue water bottle (possibly Solán de Cabras) and a tonic-style bottle; labels illegible.

subject_es: Porción de coca de calabaza con costra azucarada y capuchino espolvoreado de cacao
subject_en: Slice of pumpkin coca with a sugary crust and a cocoa-dusted cappuccino
text_snippet: PANPAN … Gran Vía Marqués del Turia 51 … COCA DE CALABAZA; CAPUCHINO; Total
notes: The PanPan receipt confirms the product names 'COCA DE CALABAZA' and 'CAPUCHINO'. Prices are not legible. Turquoise plate, wooden tray, dark table, 3D-cube tile floor.

subject_es: Café con leche con espuma en taza blanca; al fondo otra taza Lavazza y vaso con hielo
subject_en: Foamy café con leche in a white cup, with another Lavazza cup and a glass of ice behind
text_snippet: LAVAZZA; Iberitos Aceite
notes: Unremarkable, the spoon dominates. Iberitos olive-oil pot on the tray. Possibly the same visit as p045/p053.

subject_es: Batido de fresa y zumo de naranja con pajitas de papel, y porción de tarta de queso con mermelada de frambuesa y una frambuesa
subject_en: Strawberry smoothie and orange juice with paper straws, and a slice of cheesecake topped with raspberry jam and a fresh raspberry
text_snippet: GC Nature 100% Recycled (napkin); sugar sachet with café address
notes: Untreated pine wall panels behind, which matches the current interior. Crackle-glaze plate, kraft napkin. A green juice, a coffee and crackers on other trays. People at the sides show only clothing, no faces. Good colour and appetite appeal.

subject_es: Postre de chocolate en forma de tulipa (mousse envuelta en láminas de chocolate, espolvoreada de cacao) y café espresso
subject_en: Tulip-shaped chocolate dessert (mousse wrapped in chocolate sheets, dusted with cocoa) with an espresso
text_snippet: LAVAZZA (cup); pan pan · AZÚCAR BLANCO 7 Gr. (sachet)
notes: Tidy composition on a wooden tray with kraft paper and a white plate. The PanPan white-sugar sachet carries a small wordmark. Espresso in a Lavazza cup. Sunglasses at left edge.

subject_es: Zumo multivitamínico natural en vaso tallado y empanadilla de pisto en plato negro moteado, con el tique de PanPan
subject_en: Fresh multivitamin juice in a cut-glass tumbler and a pisto (ratatouille) empanadilla on a speckled black plate, with the PanPan receipt
text_snippet: PANPAN – PANBER CAFE, S.L. – C/ Gran Vía Marqués del Turia, 51 – 12/09/20 – PISTO 1,70 – MULTIV. 3,80 – Total 5,50 – IVA (10%) 0,50
notes: The receipt is sharp and gives dated 2020 prices: empanadilla de pisto €1.70, multivitamin juice €3.80. It also shows the legal entity Panber Cafe S.L. and phone 963060811. NY cap and sunglasses on the table. 3D-cube floor and wooden chairs behind.

subject_es: Tarta de queso con mermelada de frutos rojos y frambuesa, cruasán mixto de jamón york y queso y dos cafés con leche con corazón
subject_en: Cheesecake with berry jam and a raspberry, a ham-and-cheese croissant and two cafés con leche with heart latte art
notes: Tilted overhead on a dark wood table. Navy oval plate and pink plate. A person's arm with a watch at the top edge, face not visible. Phone corner at right. Same cheesecake as p060.

subject_es: Vitrina de cristal con bollería: cruasanes glaseados, piezas de hojaldre laminado espolvoreadas con azúcar glas, cruasanes rellenos de jamón york y queso, chapatas cerradas (relleno no visible), porción de pizza con verduras y aceitunas y una barra rellena en el estante superior
subject_en: Glass display counter with pastries: glazed croissants, sugar-dusted laminated pastries, croissants filled with ham and cheese, closed ciabatta rolls (filling not visible), a vegetable-and-olive pizza slice and a filled baguette on the top shelf
notes: Tilted and motion-blurred shot through the glass. White product cards on wooden stands are present but unreadable; one may start with 'NAPOLITANA', but that reading is unreliable. The counter sits on pine boards with a marble base. The top shelf holds cakes and brownies with more labels. A tart edge shows at bottom right. Useful only as evidence of what the counter holds.

subject_es: Desayuno en bandeja de bambú: media tostada de pan con semillas en la corteza, tomate triturado, aceite en monodosis, café con leche grande en taza alta y mini cruasán de almendra con almendra laminada y azúcar glas, junto al ticket
subject_en: Breakfast on a bamboo tray: half a toast of seed-crusted bread, grated tomato, a single-serve olive oil pot, a large milky coffee in a tall mug and a mini almond croissant with flaked almonds and icing sugar, next to the receipt
text_snippet: 1/2 INTEGRAL 0,75 · MINI ALMENDRA 1,20 · CAFE CON LECHE GRAND 1,90 · TOPPING TOMATE 0,50 · Total 4,35
notes: The receipt header is cut off at 'PANBE…', which is PANBER CAFE S.L., the operating company (see p071/p084), so this is the right café. The date reads 22/06 with no year. The order ticket carries a staff first name (YAMILKA). Sugar sachets are Lavazza. A pine panel with an X brace is in the background. Good for reading prices, but the receipts dominate the frame, so it is poor as a website image.

subject_es: Porción de bizcocho de miga amarilla con costra dorada y azúcar perlado en plato negro moteado, café con leche en taza y vaso de refresco de cola con limón sostenido por una mano
subject_en: Slice of yellow-crumb sponge cake with a golden crust and pearl sugar on a black speckled plate, a milky coffee in a cup, and a glass of cola with lemon held in a hand
notes: The pan pan wordmark and 'Mmmmm!' are clearly printed on the kraft sugar stick. This is the same scene as p067, which is a tighter crop without the hand. The same cake appears in p088 and p091. The flavour is not identifiable (carrot, orange or pumpkin are all possible), so do not name it.

subject_es: Porción de bizcocho de miga amarilla con azúcar perlado en plato negro moteado y café con leche en taza blanca, sobre bandeja de bambú con papel kraft
subject_en: Slice of yellow-crumb sponge cake with pearl sugar on a black speckled plate and a milky coffee in a white cup, on a bamboo tray lined with kraft paper
notes: Same scene as p066, cropped tighter with no hand. The kraft sugar stick shows the pan pan wordmark and 'Mmmmm!'. The light is warm and indoor. Usable as a small card image.

subject_es: Capuchino con abundante cacao espolvoreado y bocadillo de jamón serrano en pan de barra crujiente sobre plato celadón
subject_en: Cappuccino heavily dusted with cocoa and a cured-ham (jamón serrano) sandwich on a crusty baguette on a celadon plate
notes: A partial pan pan sugar sachet with 'Mmmmm!' is on the saucer. The sandwich is cut off at the right edge. A person in red is in the background with no face visible. The light is somewhat flat.

subject_es: Primer plano de cruasán de mantequilla glaseado y brillante; al fondo, dos cafés con leche en vaso y una pieza de bollería con azúcar glas
subject_en: Close-up of a glossy glazed butter croissant; in the background, two milky coffees in glasses and a sugar-dusted pastry
notes: Appetising close-up that shows the lamination and glaze well. A blurred hand is in the background. The croissant is cropped at both ends. This is a good candidate for a pastry detail shot.

subject_es: Café con leche con dibujo en taza, zumo de naranja y, al fondo, tostada con salmón ahumado y brotes verdes (base no visible; el ticket menciona aguacate)
subject_en: Milky coffee with latte art, fresh orange juice and, behind them, a toast topped with smoked salmon and green leaves (base not visible; the ticket mentions avocado)
text_snippet: sobre: 'G.V. Marqués del Turia, 51 · 46005 Valencia · T. 963 06 08 11'; ticket: 'CON LECHE … AGUACATE … LECHE'
notes: The white pan pan sugar sachets print the café's address and phone, which confirms the venue. The order ticket carries a staff first name (SANDRA) and the date 16/03. The coffee dominates the frame and the salmon toast is only partly visible. The table is dark.

subject_es: Dos capuchinos con canela/cacao en bandeja de bambú, con ticket de compra
subject_en: Two cappuccinos dusted with cinnamon/cocoa on a bamboo tray, with the receipt
text_snippet: PANBER CAFE, S.L. C/ Gran Via Marques del Turia, 51 · 2 CAPUCHINO 2,00 4,00 · 2 . avena 0,00 · Total 4,00 · 14/05/22
notes: The receipt gives the operating company PANBER CAFE S.L. and phone 963060811. It is dated 14/05/22: cappuccino €2.00, and oat milk costs nothing extra. The white pan pan sugar sachets are tiny. A woman's hands with a ring and a bag with a TH (Tommy Hilfiger) logo are in the frame. Useful for prices, but not for publication.

subject_es: Éclair con glaseado blanco (vainilla según ticket) en plato de cerámica estampada morada y capuchino en taza blanca
subject_en: Éclair with white icing (vanilla, per the ticket) on a purple patterned ceramic plate and a cappuccino in a white cup
text_snippet: 1 ECLAIR VAINI[LLA] · 1 CAPUCHINO · BARRA 09:2x
notes: Very tall frame (1000x2222) with a large empty table in the lower half, so it would need heavy cropping. A yellow upholstered chair is in the frame. A background fridge or counter holds jar desserts. Customers' legs are in the background with no faces. The order ticket partly shows a staff name ('…A ALF').

subject_es: Napolitana de chocolate dorada y hojaldrada en plato turquesa con borde anaranjado y café con leche en taza Lavazza
subject_en: Golden, flaky chocolate napolitana (pain au chocolat) on a turquoise plate with an orange rim, and a milky coffee in a Lavazza cup
notes: Sharp and well composed, and the chocolate layer is visible at the end. The cup carries the Lavazza logo. The dark wood table and white chair belong to the older interior. A good pastry image, though the Lavazza branding shows.

subject_es: Sándwich a la plancha partido en dos con jamón york, queso fundido, lechuga y tomate en pan con semillas, junto a café con leche
subject_en: Grilled sandwich cut in half with cooked ham, melted cheese, lettuce and tomato in seed-topped bread, with a milky coffee
notes: Clean shot with clear grill marks. It is on a white table, with the black-and-white 3D cube-tile floor behind. Good for the savoury section.

subject_es: Muffin de manzana con láminas de manzana y costra de azúcar en cápsula de papel, sobre plato turquesa, y vaso de café con leche muy claro
subject_en: Apple muffin topped with apple slices and a sugar crust in a paper tulip case on a turquoise plate, with a glass of very milky coffee
notes: Well lit and sharp. It is on a white round table with a marble wall behind. A person's legs in green trousers are in the background. The drink could also be plain milk or tea with milk.

subject_es: Dos napolitanas horneadas y brillantes (relleno no visible) en platos de cerámica, con cafés en tazas Lavazza
subject_en: Two glossy baked napolitanas (filling not visible) on ceramic plates, with coffees in Lavazza cups
notes: The foreground napolitana is slightly soft and the image looks over-processed. The Lavazza logo is partly visible on the cup. A person in a polka-dot top sits behind with no face visible. There is an Aztec-pattern cushion. Red lettering on a white item at the right edge ('MAC…') is probably a bag.

subject_es: Dos bocadillos en pan de barra (uno con jamón serrano visible, el otro cerrado), dos capuchinos con cacao y un cruasán bañado a medias en chocolate con cobertura crujiente
subject_en: Two baguette sandwiches (one with visible cured ham, the other closed), two cocoa-dusted cappuccinos and a croissant half-dipped in chocolate with a crunchy topping
notes: The receipt on the table is too blurry to read; the header may say 'PANPAN' and the total looks like about 12,1x, which is unreliable. A man in a red T-shirt shows his arms, with no face. The table is dark and the floor is grey tile. The chocolate-dipped croissant is an interesting product.

subject_es: Empanadilla dorada con repulgue en plato negro moteado, porción de bizcocho de molde en plato de cerámica azul y blanca y café con leche
subject_en: Golden crimped empanadilla on a black speckled plate, a slice of loaf cake on a blue-and-white ceramic plate, and a milky coffee
notes: The empanadilla filling is not visible. A Lavazza sugar sachet is on the saucer. There is a white chevron (zigzag) film on the window behind, the same motif as in p079. The table is grey. Decent daylight.

subject_es: Dos éclairs con hilos de chocolate en plato estampado, capuchino con canela y café solo, junto al ventanal que da a la Gran Vía
subject_en: Two éclairs piped with chocolate on a patterned plate, a cinnamon-dusted cappuccino and an espresso, by the window onto Gran Vía
notes: Tall frame (1000x2222). The foreground coffee is soft. A seated woman is seen from the side and behind, with no face. Pedestrians on the street are small and incidental. The window has a white chevron film and there is a brown panel with a zigzag motif at the right. A pan pan 'Mmmmm!' sugar stick is on the saucer. Useful for its street and window context.

subject_es: Porción de bizcocho de almendra con almendra laminada tostada y azúcar glas en plato de mosaico, junto a capuchino con cacao
subject_en: Slice of almond sponge cake with toasted flaked almonds and icing sugar on a mosaic-pattern plate, next to a cocoa-dusted cappuccino
notes: Noticeably blurry. It is on a white table with the 3D cube-tile floor at the left.

subject_es: Tostada de pan de barra con aceite de oliva, tomate triturado en cuenco aparte y café con leche con dibujo, en plato azul marino
subject_en: Baguette toast drizzled with olive oil, grated tomato in a separate dish and a latte-art milky coffee, on a navy-blue plate
notes: Sunglasses are on the table and a guest's lap and legs are in the frame, so it would need cropping. It shows a rattan chair, a white chair and the cube-tile floor. The white sugar stick carries the address in tiny print.

subject_es: Tres piezas de bollería laminada en forma de media luna espolvoreadas con azúcar glas (relleno no visible) en plato mostaza, y café bombón en vaso Lavazza
subject_en: Three crescent-shaped laminated pastries dusted with icing sugar (filling not visible) on a mustard plate, and a café bombón (espresso over condensed milk) in a Lavazza glass
notes: Probably the same product as p093, where the ticket reads 'CR. MINI CHOCOLA'. The same striated pastries appear in the p064 counter. The Lavazza logo is on the glass. This is the older interior: dark wood table, a zinc bucket with bottles, white chairs and a marble counter.

subject_es: Desayuno: cruasán de mantequilla glaseado en plato estampado burdeos, capuchino con canela y zumo de naranja natural
subject_en: Breakfast: glazed butter croissant on a burgundy patterned plate, a cinnamon-dusted cappuccino and fresh orange juice
notes: Well lit and appetising, and a good breakfast candidate. The pan pan sugar sachets read 'AZÚCAR BLANCO'. The ticket is partly hidden and carries a staff first name (MARIA) and the date 14/11. Pine chairs with X-backs and the cube-tile floor are in the background.

subject_es: Vista cenital: media tostada de pan integral con semillas en la corteza en plato azul y blanco, tomate triturado, aceite Sierra de Utiel en monodosis y café americano
subject_en: Overhead: half a toast of wholemeal bread with a seeded crust on a blue-and-white plate, grated tomato, a single-serve pot of Sierra de Utiel olive oil and a café americano
text_snippet: PANPAN · PANBER CAFE, S.L. · 1/2 INTEGRAL 0,65 · CAFE AMERICANO 1,40 · TOPPING TOMATE 0,50 · Total 2,55 · 11/07/22
notes: 'PANPAN' is printed in plain type at the top of the receipt; it is not the logo. The receipt is dated 11/07/22 and priced 1/2 integral at €0.65, against €0.75 in p065. A second order ticket lists COLACAO, leche natural, AGUA PLASTICO PE, CAPUCHINO and VASO DE FRUTA (PEDIDO NÚMERO: 11). The receipts clutter the frame, so crop to the toast.

subject_es: Surtido de bollería mini en la terraza: minicruasanes glaseados, pieza con costra de azúcar, mini napolitana con hilos de chocolate, y capuchino
subject_en: Assorted mini pastries on the terrace: glazed mini croissants, a sugar-crusted bun and a mini napolitana with chocolate stripes, with a cappuccino
notes: This is the terrace. The black table carries a printed Estrella Galicia logo, the beer brand's sponsored furniture, as in p092; it is not a different venue. A torn pan pan 'Mmmmm' sachet is on the tray. The ticket shows BARRA 09:24. The plates are coral and teal.

subject_es: Tostada de pan rústico de miga alveolada en plato craquelado, tomate triturado en cuenco y café solo en taza
subject_en: Toast of open-crumb rustic bread on a crackle-glaze plate, grated tomato in a small bowl and an espresso
notes: A 'Mmmmm' sugar stick, a salt sachet and an olive-oil pot with a green lid are on the tray. The napkin has stains. Overhead angle in flat light.

subject_es: Desayuno: tostada de pan integral en plato estampado azul, mermelada de naranja o melocotón, mantequilla Président, zumo de naranja y café con leche en vaso
subject_en: Breakfast: wholemeal toast on a blue patterned plate, orange or peach jam, Président butter, orange juice and a milky coffee in a glass
notes: Slightly tilted and soft. The Président butter branding is visible. A hand holding a spoon is in the background. The table is dark wood.

subject_es: Porción de bizcocho de miga amarilla con azúcar perlado en plato negro moteado y café con leche en taza blanca
subject_en: Slice of yellow-crumb sponge cake with pearl sugar on a black speckled plate and a milky coffee in a white cup
notes: Same cake as p066, p067 and p091. The napkin is printed 'GC Natur 100% Recycled'. The guest's knee in jeans is at the bottom. A white X-back stool stands behind. The table is dark. Tall frame.

subject_es: Dos desayunos en bandejas de bambú: cruasán glaseado, zumo de naranja y café americano delante; tostada con tomate triturado, zumo de naranja y café con leche detrás
subject_en: Two breakfasts on bamboo trays: glazed croissant, orange juice and a café americano in front; toast with grated tomato, orange juice and a milky coffee behind
notes: Strong breakfast image. The untreated pine wall panel matches the current interior, along with a white chair and a plant. The receipt under the glass is partly legible ('…Marques del Turia, 51', 'Tel.: 963060811', '?7/09/23') but its prices are hidden. There is a Lavazza sugar sachet.

subject_es: Empanada grande horneada con repulgue en plato de mosaico y café cortado en taza blanca
subject_en: Large baked empanada with a crimped edge on a mosaic-pattern plate and a cortado in a white cup
notes: Filling not visible. It looks like the terrace: a dark outdoor table and a person's torso behind with no face. The cup is half drunk.

subject_es: Bizcocho de miga amarilla con costra de azúcar y cruasán con azúcar glas (relleno no visible) en plato turquesa, con café con leche en vaso y sobre de leche condensada
subject_en: Yellow-crumb sponge cake with a sugar crust and an icing-sugar-dusted croissant (filling not visible) on a turquoise plate, with a milky coffee in a glass and a condensed-milk sachet
text_snippet: LECHE CONDENSADA (sobre)
notes: A bite has been taken from the cake. In the background are a green mug of tea or infusion and a slice of cheesecake- or flan-type tart with a caramelised top. A guest in a grey sweater shows their arms. Same cake as p066, p067 and p088.

subject_es: Terraza en la Gran Vía: cruasán glaseado sobre servilleta, porción de pizza de tomate y queso gratinado y café con leche con corazón, con árboles y tráfico al fondo
subject_en: Terrace on Gran Vía: a glazed croissant on a napkin, a slice of tomato-and-cheese pizza and a milky coffee with a latte-art heart, with trees and traffic behind
text_snippet: Estrella Galicia RESISTENCIA DESDE 1906
notes: Sunny and attractive, but the Estrella Galicia branding is prominent on the terrace screens and table; it is sponsored furniture, not another venue. A white pan pan sugar sachet is on the saucer, too small to count as the logo. This is the best terrace shot in this batch.

subject_es: Dos cruasanes laminados espolvoreados con azúcar glas (mini de chocolate según ticket; relleno no visible) en plato mostaza y café bombón en vaso
subject_en: Two laminated croissants dusted with icing sugar (mini chocolate croissants per the ticket; filling not visible) on a mustard plate, and a café bombón in a glass
text_snippet: 2 CR. MINI CHOCOLA · 1 BOMBON · BARRA 16:34 · 21/03
notes: The ticket names the products and confirms the café bombón, but gives no prices. It carries a staff first name (BERNAT) and PEDIDO NÚMERO: 54. There is a condensed-milk sachet. The glass carries partial Lavazza lettering. Dark table, older interior. Same product family as p082.

subject_es: Café con leche en taza Lavazza en primer plano y dos cruasanes glaseados (uno mini) en plato verde azulado
subject_en: Milky coffee in a Lavazza cup in the foreground and two glazed croissants (one mini) on a teal plate
notes: The Lavazza logo on the cup is prominent. The croissants look good but the cup dominates the frame. Low-light indoor shot.

subject_es: Capuchino con cacao, empanadilla glaseada en plato de mosaico, bocadillo de jamón serrano en barra y café con leche, sobre bandejas de bambú
subject_en: Cocoa-dusted cappuccino, a glazed empanadilla on a mosaic plate, a cured-ham baguette sandwich and a milky coffee, on bamboo trays
notes: Good overview of a typical order. It shows a white table, the cube-tile floor, a rattan chair, a brown upholstered chair and a pine wall panel at the right, which match the current interior. A guest's knees and legs are at the bottom and could be cropped.

subject_es: Desayuno en bandejas de bambú: dos empanadillas de hojaldre con semillas de amapola en plato de cerámica de azulejo azul, zumo de naranja, café con leche con arte latte (corazón) y dos cruasanes de mantequilla en plato de borde azul (relleno de las empanadillas no visible)
subject_en: Breakfast on bamboo trays: two poppy-seed-topped puff-pastry empanadillas on a blue tile-pattern plate, orange juice, a latte with heart latte art and two butter croissants on a blue-rimmed plate (empanadilla filling not visible)
notes: Guest photo, well lit and appetising. Torso of a seated person (no face) at the top and a leg at the right edge. Glimpse of the grey-and-white cube hydraulic floor at bottom right, same floor as p099/p105.

subject_es: Cruasán mini de mantequilla en plato de borde azul, cortado en vaso y café con leche en taza, con el ticket de PanPan sobre la bandeja
subject_en: Mini butter croissant on a blue-rimmed plate, a cortado in a glass and a milky coffee in a cup, with the PanPan receipt on the tray
text_snippet: PANPAN / PANBER CAFE, S.L. / C/. Gran via Marques del Turia, 51 / CRUASAN MINI / CAFE CON ... / CORTADO / . avena
notes: The receipt header reads PANPAN in plain type, so it is a wordmark rather than the graphic logo. Receipt is upside down and the plate hides its prices. Oat milk ('avena') modifier listed. Blue Lavazza-style sugar sachets. Knit sweater of a person in the background (no face).

subject_es: Dos bandejas vistas desde arriba: cruasán de almendra con azúcar glas y almendra laminada junto a un café con leche en vaso; cruasán de mantequilla con otro café con leche en vaso
subject_en: Two trays shot from above: an almond croissant dusted with icing sugar and flaked almonds beside a milky coffee in a glass, and a butter croissant with another milky coffee in a glass
notes: Clean flat-lay with good natural light on speckled blue-dot plates, bamboo trays with kraft paper liners and cutlery. Small stains on the liner. Vertical crop, good for a gallery.

subject_es: Capuchino con arte latte (roseta) y cruasán de mantequilla en plato oscuro moteado, sobre bandeja de bambú
subject_en: Cappuccino with rosetta latte art and a butter croissant on a dark speckled plate, on a bamboo tray
text_snippet: LAVAZZA Torino Italia 1895 (sugar sachet)
notes: Lavazza sugar sachet on the saucer. Background shows the cube hydraulic floor, a yellow chair and feet of a passer-by (no face). A handwritten notebook page is visible at bottom left and could be cropped out.

subject_es: Vista cenital: dos capuchinos con arte latte, cruasán de mantequilla en plato oscuro y porción de bizcocho de molde con costra de azúcar en plato craquelado (sabor no visible)
subject_en: Overhead view: two cappuccinos with latte art, a butter croissant on a dark plate and a slice of sugar-crusted loaf cake on a crackle-glaze plate (flavour not visible)
text_snippet: 'pan pan' on sugar sachet; Santander card slip '5,75 EUR' (low legibility)
notes: Sugar sachet carries the 'pan pan' wordmark. Taken on the solid pine table with bamboo trays. A card-payment slip with the Santander logo is tucked under the fork. Someone's yellow scarf or legs show at the bottom edge.

subject_es: Dos mini cruasanes de chocolate espolvoreados con azúcar glas en plato craquelado y café solo en taza Lavazza, con el ticket
subject_en: Two mini chocolate croissants dusted with icing sugar on a crackle-glaze plate and an espresso in a Lavazza cup, with the receipt
text_snippet: 17/11/21 · MINI CHOCOLA 0,70 (x2 = 1,40) · CAFE SOLO 1,20 · Total 2,60 · IVA 10% · TARJETA
notes: Price evidence dated 17/11/2021: mini chocolate croissant €0.70, café solo €1.20 (prices likely outdated). The espresso cup has the Lavazza logo. Dim, warm light.

subject_es: Porción de tarta red velvet de dos capas con crema de queso y roseta de crema encima; taza verde de leche caliente con sobre de Cola Cao
subject_en: Two-layer red velvet cake slice with cream-cheese frosting and a piped cream rosette; green mug of hot milk with a Cola Cao sachet
text_snippet: ColaCao Original
notes: A woman's torso (green jumper, scarf, hair, face out of frame) fills the background. A hand is at bottom left. The Cola Cao branding is prominent, so it is not ideal for publishing. Cake plate is pale blue.

subject_es: Fachada de PanPan en la Gran Vía Marqués del Turia: logotipo 'pan pan' con motivo chevrón en el muro de acero corten, puerta de cristal con vinilos 'La Festa de l'Amor' y 'Feliç 9 d'octubre', mesa alta con taburetes en la entrada
subject_en: PanPan storefront on Gran Vía Marqués del Turia: 'pan pan' logo with chevron motif on the rust-brown wall, glass door with 'La Festa de l'Amor' and 'Feliç 9 d'octubre' window vinyls, high table with stools at the entrance
text_snippet: pan pan · La Festa de l'Amor · Feliç 9 d'octubre · mmh mmm!
notes: Google date 2023-10-12, and the seasonal 9 d'Octubre vinyl fits that date. The fascia above carries the neighbouring 'Pepe Boví Ópticos' sign, a different business, so it may need cropping. Small people are visible inside and in window reflections.

subject_es: Vitrina con bandejas de pino llenas de empanadillas (ternera, pollo, espinacas y otra etiqueta cortada 'Pi…'), con napolitanas y cruasanes a la izquierda y porciones de pizza y quiches en el estante superior
subject_en: Display case with pine trays full of empanadillas (beef, chicken, spinach and one cut-off 'Pi…' label), with napolitanas and croissants on the left and pizza slices and quiches on the top shelf
text_snippet: EMPANADILLA Ternera 2,20€ · EMPANADILLA Pollo 2,20€ · EMPANADILLA Espinacas 2€ · EMPANADILLA Pi… (cut off)
notes: Best empanadilla shot in this batch: sharp, good light, appetising. The white price labels with the chevron pattern sit on wooden block holders. Espinacas costs 2€ here but 1,95€ in p126, so p104 is probably newer. Undated.

subject_es: Interior en hora punta: cola de clientas ante la barra, camarero con delantal de rayas sirviendo y vitrina refrigerada vertical con tartas y postres en vasito; suelo hidráulico de cubos
subject_en: Interior at rush hour: a queue of customers at the counter, a server in a striped apron and a vertical refrigerated cabinet of cakes and dessert pots; cube-pattern hydraulic floor
notes: Several customers and a staff member are identifiable in profile, so do not publish. Useful as a documentary shot of the chain-link metal curtain on the upper wall, the pendant lamps, the window with the chevron vinyl and the cake cabinet. A WiFi sign ('Repeti…') is cut off at top right.

subject_es: Fotograma de vídeo: letras corpóreas 'Saborea la vi[da]… si[n prisa]' sobre panel de pino, con espigas de trigo secas tras un cristal
subject_en: Video frame: raised lettering 'Saborea la vi[da]… si[n prisa]' on a pine panel, with dried wheat stalks behind glass
text_snippet: Saborea la … s…
notes: Video thumbnail ('Google Videos', 1080x1920, dated 2026-05-22). The crop is awkward with the text cut off. Same wall as p107/p108/p114/p115/p122/p123.

subject_es: Rincón con banco corrido y cojines estampados bajo el lema 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' sobre paneles de pino; estantes iluminados con macetas de lavanda y suelo hidráulico de cubos
subject_en: Corner nook with a built-in bench and patterned cushions under the slogan 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' on pine panels; backlit niches with lavender pots and cube-pattern hydraulic floor
text_snippet: Saborea la vida... sin prisa
notes: Clean, empty, well-lit interior and a strong candidate for the interior gallery. Dried wheat is visible behind the glass above. Mixed chairs. The bench has cushions here, while p108/p123 show a plain brown upholstered bench, so this may be an older or newer layout.

subject_es: Lema 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' en panel de pino sobre banco tapizado marrón, con espigas de trigo tras el cristal; mesa oscura en primer plano
subject_en: 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' slogan on a pine panel above a brown upholstered bench, wheat stalks behind glass; dark table in the foreground
text_snippet: Saborea la vida... sin prisa
notes: Low, tilted angle with the table top taking up the lower half. A crumpled cloth or jacket lies on the bench. Same wall as p107/p115/p123.

subject_es: Primer plano desenfocado de un café solo con crema en taza Lavazza
subject_en: Blurry close-up of an espresso with crema in a Lavazza cup
text_snippet: LAVAZZA
notes: Video thumbnail ('Google Videos'). Out of focus and unusable. The cup logo is Lavazza, not PanPan.

subject_es: Vista del salón desde una mesa: taza de té con infusor y lector de libros electrónicos sobre bandeja de bambú; al fondo sillas de mimbre y amarillas, barra de mármol con vitrinas de cristal, pizarras de menú de madera y escaparate a la Gran Vía
subject_en: Café interior from a table: tea mug with infuser and an e-reader on a bamboo tray; behind, rattan and yellow chairs, the marble counter with glass cases, wooden menu boards and the window onto Gran Vía
notes: Google date 2023-07-22. The vertical 'pan pan' logo and chevron tile are visible on the column by the window. Current-style wooden menu boards and the aluminium chain-link curtain above the counter are visible, but the boards are unreadable at this resolution. Tiny pedestrians show outside. The e-reader in the foreground is personal clutter.

subject_es: Fachada con tres logotipos 'pan pan' con motivo chevrón, persianas venecianas bajadas, vinilo 'Mmm mmm!', olivo en maceta de fibra y carrito metálico con plantas en la entrada
subject_en: Storefront with three 'pan pan' logos and chevron motif, lowered venetian blinds, 'Mmm mmm!' window vinyl, a potted olive tree in a woven planter and a metal plant trolley at the entrance
notes: Sunny, clean shot with no people. The neighbouring 'Pepe Boví Ópticos' sign is cut off at the top and a neighbouring shop ('REBA…') is at the left edge. The blinds are down (early morning or closed).

subject_es: Interior de noche: barra de mármol con vitrinas de bollería, cafetera espresso de tres grupos, pizarras de menú de madera y vitrina refrigerada vertical de tartas; cortina de malla metálica bajo el techo
subject_en: Interior at night: marble counter with pastry cases, a three-group espresso machine, wooden menu boards and a vertical refrigerated cake cabinet; metal chain-link curtain below the ceiling
text_snippet: Repetir es buena señal. La de nuestro Wi-Fi, también. · Mmm mmmm!
notes: A good wide shot of the counter with no people. The 'pan pan' logo is on the window-side column at the left. The menu boards (current wooden style, brown type) are too small to read. The espresso machine brand is illegible. Cakes are visible in the fridge. Warm evening light.

subject_es: Acera de la Gran Vía con la fachada de PanPan: banderola 'pan pan', clientas en mesas altas junto a la puerta y pizarra de caballete con 'Menú desayunos, coffee & tés, zumos naturales, smoothies, empanadillas, tostas, ensaladas'
subject_en: Gran Vía pavement with the PanPan storefront: 'pan pan' blade sign, customers at high tables by the door and an A-frame chalkboard listing 'Menú desayunos, coffee & tés, zumos naturales, smoothies, empanadillas, tostas, ensaladas'
text_snippet: Menú desayunos · Coffee & tés · Zumos naturales · Smoothies · Empanadillas · Tostas · Ensaladas · Pan…
notes: The chalkboard A-frame confirms the product range (no prices). An elderly woman seen from behind blocks part of the board. Small customers sit at the entrance. A neighbouring shop with a metal grille is at the left and the Pepe Boví optics sign is above. Overcast.

subject_es: Rincón 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' con mesas pequeñas, banco con cojines de colores, estantes iluminados con plantas, libros y adornos, y suelo hidráulico de cubos
subject_en: 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' corner with small tables, a bench with coloured cushions, backlit shelves with plants, books and ornaments, and the cube-pattern floor
text_snippet: Saborea la vida... sin prisa
notes: Same nook as p107 with used tables (cups, bottles). A person's dark clothing shows at the left edge (no face). There is a small notice on the shelf (unreadable). The layout looks older, with cushions and different chairs.

subject_es: Detalle del lema en letras corpóreas grises 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' sobre paneles de pino, con espigas de trigo tras el cristal
subject_en: Close-up of the grey raised-letter slogan 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' on pine panels, with wheat stalks behind the glass
text_snippet: Saborea la vida... sin prisa
notes: Sharp, clean detail that works as a brand or atmosphere image or section divider. Same wall as p106/p107/p108/p123.

subject_es: Mesa alta de madera maciza con taburetes blancos junto al escaparate, lámparas colgantes grises y vista a los árboles y edificios de la Gran Vía
subject_en: Solid-wood high table with white stools by the shop window, grey pendant lamps and a view of Gran Vía's trees and buildings
notes: Bright, sunny and empty, with a wide-angle look. The window carries the 'La Festa de l'Amor / 9 d'Octubre' vinyl seen from inside (reversed), so it was taken around October, same period as p103. A security camera dome is on the ceiling.

subject_es: Pared blanca con tablones de madera y macetas de zinc colgadas con plantas; mesas oscuras con sillas blancas y cojines amarillos; extintor en la esquina
subject_en: White wall with wooden planks holding hanging zinc pots of plants; dark tables with white chairs and yellow cushions; fire extinguisher in the corner
notes: A decorative plant wall. The fire extinguisher, 'EXTINTOR' sign and cleaning spray bottle hurt it for publishing unless cropped. This decor is not seen in other shots, so it may be an older layout or another corner.

subject_es: Dos estantes empotrados iluminados con plantas, libros, reloj de madera y letras 'BOOK'; mesa oscura y sillas tapizadas en primer plano
subject_en: Two backlit recessed shelves with plants, books, a wooden clock and 'BOOK' letters; dark table and upholstered chairs in the foreground
notes: Same lit niches as p107/p114. A plain composition with a white table corner and chair cut off in the foreground.

subject_es: Vitrina sobre mostrador de mármol: mini cruasanes, panquemados, ensaimadas con azúcar glas, cruasanes de mantequilla y de chocolate, cruasanes salados y empanadillas; en el estante superior bocadillos, porciones de pizza y bollería, con etiquetas de precio
subject_en: Display case on the marble counter: mini croissants, panquemados, icing-sugar ensaimadas, butter and chocolate croissants, filled savoury croissants and empanadillas; top shelf with baguette sandwiches, pizza slices and pastries, all with price labels
text_snippet: MINI CROISSANT mantequilla 0,6?€ · PANQUEMADO 1,?€ · CRUASÁN mantequilla 1,4?€ · CRUASÁN CHOCO mini 0,7?€ · EMPANADILLA Ternera 2,??€ (low legibility)
notes: The labels are too small and glary to read prices reliably, so do not use them for pricing. Upper boards partly show text ('+0,20 € más…', 'Por 1€ más…'). A customer's black-sleeved arm is at the right edge. A staff figure or reflection behind the glass is blurred. Open kitchen with white metro tiles and a knife rack is visible.

subject_es: Interior con clienta pidiendo en la barra, vitrina refrigerada de tartas, cartel del wifi, pizarras de menú de madera y acceso a la zona de obrador; carrito de bebé en primer plano
subject_en: Interior with a customer ordering at the counter, refrigerated cake cabinet, WiFi sign, wooden menu boards and a doorway to the back/kitchen area; baby stroller in the foreground
text_snippet: WC · Repetir es buena señal… Wi-Fi también
notes: Cluttered by the stroller and bags in the foreground. The man at left on his phone has his face partly visible. The 'pan pan' logo is on the left column. It shows the chain-link curtains, pine-panelled WC wall and back storage area (not flattering).

subject_es: Contrapicado de la fachada: banderola 'pan pan' con chevrones, cierres metálicos con dibujo de chevrón bajados, edificio de la Gran Vía y plátano con bandera valenciana
subject_en: Low-angle view of the storefront: 'pan pan' blade sign with chevrons, lowered chevron-pattern shutters, the Gran Vía building and a plane tree with the Valencian flag
notes: Bright, saturated and good for the logo or location. The shutters are down (closed). The neighbouring Pepe Boví optics lettering shows on the glass fascia. It may be slightly over-processed (HDR look).

subject_es: Clienta con gafas y camiseta amarilla posando en una mesa ante el lema 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa'
subject_en: Customer in glasses and a yellow T-shirt posing at a table in front of the 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' wall
text_snippet: Saborea la vida... sin prisa · benetton (T-shirt)
notes: A personal portrait and not publishable. A second person is in the background. It shows the brown upholstered bench and cube floor.

subject_es: Lema 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' sobre panel de pino y espigas de trigo tras el cristal, con banco tapizado marrón debajo
subject_en: 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' slogan on a pine panel with wheat stalks behind glass, brown upholstered bench below
text_snippet: Saborea la vida... sin prisa
notes: Slightly soft with a bright ceiling cove. Duplicate of p115/p108 with weaker quality.

subject_es: Monumento fallero de figuras de colores (ciervo alado, dama con abanico, león chino) con multitud en la calle durante las Fallas
subject_en: Fallas monument of colourful figures (winged deer, lady with a fan, Chinese lion) with a crowd in the street during the Fallas festival
notes: Not the café. It is a street scene, probably shot from the café's doorway or nearby during Fallas (a black frame edge shows at top right). Many identifiable faces. Exclude.

subject_es: Ticket de PanPan (Panber Café, S.L., Gran Vía Marqués del Turia 51) del 25/06/2017: 2 'Desayuno Mediterráneo' a 3,50 € = 7,00 €, pago al contado
subject_en: PanPan receipt (Panber Café, S.L., Gran Vía Marqués del Turia 51) dated 25/06/2017: 2 'Desayuno Mediterráneo' at €3.50 = €7.00, paid in cash
text_snippet: PANPAN · PANBER CAFE, S.L. · 25/06/17 · 2 DESAYUNO MEDITERRANE 3,50 7,00 · Total 7,00 · Iva (10%) 0,64
notes: Receipt only. PANPAN appears in printed receipt type. It is fully legible and gives 2017 price history (Desayuno Mediterráneo €3.50), which is outdated. Tel 963060811, CIF B-98853757. Photographed on the pine table.

subject_es: Vitrina con napolitanas en pizarra, filas de empanadillas, ensaimadas y cruasanes en cesta, bocadillos, porciones de pizza y quiches, con etiquetas de precio
subject_en: Display case with napolitanas on slate, rows of empanadillas, ensaimadas and croissants in a basket, baguette sandwiches, pizza slices and quiches, with price labels
text_snippet: QUICHE York y Queso 1,95€ · PIZZA Cuatro quesos 2,75€ · PIZZA Verduras 2,75€ · EMPANADILLA Espinacas 1,95€ · EMPANADILLA Pisto 1,95€ · COOKIE Pepitas chocolate 1,5?€
notes: Reflections on the glass. A blurred staff member in a white shirt is behind the case (no clear face) and there are tiny pedestrians outside. Prices look older than p104 (Espinacas 1,95€ vs 2€). The Ternera and Pollo labels are too blurred to read. 'Pisto' is a probable reading.

subject_es: Salón de día con mesas y sillas de madera, barra de mármol con vitrinas de bollería, exprimidora de naranjas, estantes con tarros y cortina de malla metálica; logotipo 'pan pan' en la columna junto al escaparate
subject_en: Daytime dining room with wooden tables and chairs, marble counter with pastry cases, an orange-juice machine, shelves of jars and a metal chain-link curtain; 'pan pan' logo on the column by the window
notes: Two customers are seated at the window with their backs to the camera, and a third is cut off at the left edge (no faces). No wooden menu boards on the back wall, which has a white wire bread rack instead, so this is likely an older layout. Slightly dim and soft.

subject_es: Vitrina refrigerada vertical de pastelería: lionesas rellenas de nata, tulipas de mousse de chocolate, cúpulas de chocolate con leche, éclairs de chocolate y de café, porciones de capas tipo tiramisú, pasteles de capas con cobertura de yema tostada, tartaletas de mousse con glaseado de frutos rojos, cúpulas de glaseado amarillo pálido, anillos glaseados de chocolate y vasitos de postre
subject_en: Tall refrigerated pastry cabinet: cream-filled choux puffs, chocolate mousse tulips, milk-chocolate domes, chocolate and coffee éclairs, tiramisu-style layered bars, layered cakes with toasted-yolk topping, mousse tartlets with berry glaze, pale-yellow glazed domes, chocolate-glazed rings and dessert jars
notes: Same tall cake cabinet as p131, shot straight on through the glass. Crowded framing, some glare from the LED strips and glass reflections. No labels are visible. The layered cakes with a toasted-yolk top look like San Marcos, which appears on receipt p151 at 2,95. Flavours are not identifiable, so they are described by colour only.

subject_es: Jardín vertical de plantas y flores artificiales en macetas de zinc sobre tablones de madera rústica; debajo, mesa con ensalada en bol (aparentemente atún y bolitas de mozzarella) sobre bandeja de madera, vinagreta en tarrina, vaso y botella de agua
subject_en: Vertical garden of artificial plants and flowers in zinc pots on rustic wooden planks; below, a table with a salad bowl (apparently tuna and mozzarella balls) on a wooden tray, dressing pot, glass and water bottle
notes: This is the same plant wall seen in p137 and p155. The salad is small and cropped at the bottom edge. A coat hangs on a chair at the right. The water bottle has a blue label with an unreadable brand. White wall, rear dining area.

subject_es: Dos hornacinas de madera de pino iluminadas con LED en pared gris: plantas artificiales en cestas y macetas, libros, reloj de madera con forma de oso y sujetalibros con la palabra BOOK
subject_en: Two LED-lit pine-wood wall niches on a grey wall: artificial plants in baskets and pots, books, a bear-shaped wooden clock and BOOK bookends
text_snippet: BO OK (bookends)
notes: Clean, symmetrical decor detail that would work as a secondary or ambience image. The same niches appear in p137, p150 and behind the guest in p157.

subject_es: Vitrina refrigerada vertical completa de pastelería: cúpulas de caramelo, vasitos de postre de chocolate y nata, éclairs de café y de chocolate, mousses en forma de pétalo de chocolate blanco y con leche, porciones de capas tipo ópera, cúpulas glaseadas amarillas, cúpulas de chocolate con decoración blanca, tartaletas glaseadas de frutos rojos, anillos de chocolate y porciones de capas con crema
subject_en: Full tall refrigerated pastry cabinet: caramel domes, chocolate-and-cream dessert jars, coffee and chocolate éclairs, white- and milk-chocolate petal mousses, opera-style layered slices, yellow glazed domes, chocolate domes with white drizzle, berry-glazed tartlets, chocolate rings and layered cream slices
notes: Same cabinet as p128, shown whole with its frame. Reflections on the glass, grey floor tiles on the right. There are no price labels. It documents the pastry range well but is not a hero shot.

subject_es: Sala durante la pandemia: camarero con gorra y delantal marrón llevando una bandeja entre mesas redondas de madera, clientes con mascarilla y un hombre de pie junto a la entrada; al fondo, cristalera con vinilo de zigzag hacia la Gran Vía
subject_en: Dining room during the pandemic: waiter in a flat cap and brown apron carrying a tray between round wooden tables, masked guests and a man standing by the entrance; zigzag-frosted glass front onto Gran Vía behind
notes: COVID era (masks), probably 2020–21. The waiter is in the centre of the frame, with his face masked. An out-of-focus bare arm fills the lower right, and the lighting is flat. The floor shows the cube-pattern tiles of the rear area.

subject_es: Monumento fallero de temática marina (sirenas, peces, pulpo) en una plaza de Valencia
subject_en: Fallas monument with a marine theme (mermaids, fish, octopus) in a Valencia square
notes: Off-topic Fallas festival photo, not taken at the café. Do not publish.

subject_es: Fachada de PanPan en la Gran Vía: pared marrón con el logotipo Pan Pan y el motivo de zigzag, puerta de cristal con vinilo Mmm mmm! y zigzag esmerilado, sombras de los árboles sobre la acera; encima, el rótulo de Pepe Bosca Ópticos
subject_en: PanPan frontage on Gran Vía: brown wall with the Pan Pan logo and zigzag mark, glass door with Mmm mmm! lettering and frosted zigzag, dappled tree shadows on the pavement; Pepe Bosca Ópticos sign above
text_snippet: Mmm mmm! · Horario: De lunes a sábado de 7:30 a 21:00 h. Domingos y festivos de 8:30 a 15:00 h (small print on the door, approximate) · Admitimos tarjetas de crédito
notes: The metal Pan Pan wordmark and zigzag logo are on the brown wall. A young man in a cap stands at the left with his face half hidden by his hand, with a woman behind him. Very tall crop with a lot of empty pavement. The neighbouring optician's sign (Pepe Bosca Ópticos) is visible at the top. The opening hours on the door are tiny, so the digits are uncertain.

subject_es: Barra de mármol de Carrara con vitrina de cristal, cafetera espresso, molinillo, exprimidor de naranjas y cestas de pan; pizarras negras de desayunos y menús de ensaladas, cortina de cadena de aluminio y lámparas colgantes blancas
subject_en: Carrara marble counter with glass display, espresso machine, grinder, orange juicer and bread baskets; black chalkboards for breakfasts and salad menus, aluminium chain-link curtain and white pendant lamps
text_snippet: DESAYUNOS: Mediterráneo 3,50€? · Healthy 6,50€? · MERIENDAS 2,50€ · MENÚS ENSALADAS: Menú Básico 6,75€ (ensalada + bebida + café o té) · Menú Completo 9,25€ (ensalada + tosta + bebida + café o té)
notes: Older handwritten black chalkboards, an earlier generation than the printed black boards in p149/p158. Salad menu prices of 6,75€ and 9,25€ are fairly legible. The Desayunos prices are blurry, so treat 3,50 and 6,50 as uncertain. The vertical Pan Pan logo with chevron is on the entrance column at the left. Good, well-lit overview of the old counter. The Mmm mmm! window vinyl is also visible.

subject_es: Monumento fallero «Hipatia» (alquimia, matraces y figuras) ante edificios modernistas
subject_en: Fallas monument «Hipatia» (alchemy, flasks and figures) in front of Art Nouveau buildings
text_snippet: HIPATIA · San Miguel
notes: Off-topic Fallas photo. It includes San Miguel beer sponsorship signage. Do not publish.

subject_es: Sala del fondo vacía: pared de listones de madera con el lema «Saborea la vida… sin prisa», banco corrido, mesas redondas de madera con sillas mixtas (blancas, madera, gris estilo Eames), hornacinas iluminadas y jardín vertical; techo de placas perforadas con focos
subject_en: Empty rear dining area: wooden slat wall reading «Saborea la vida… sin prisa», banquette, round wooden tables with mixed chairs (white, wood, grey Eames-style), lit niches and vertical garden; perforated ceiling tiles with spotlights
text_snippet: Saborea la vida… sin prisa · EXTINTOR
notes: Wide shot with no people. The ceiling takes up nearly half the frame, and a fire extinguisher and sign are prominent. The cube-pattern floor tiles by the banquette are visible. The walls here are white, not grey.

subject_es: Monumento fallero premiado en 2023 (cocodrilo, flamencos, animales músicos) en una calle del centro

subject_es: Suelo de baldosas hidráulicas con dibujo de cubos en perspectiva (blanco, gris y antracita) entre patas de sillas de madera

subject_es: Vista longitudinal del local: larga barra de mármol con vitrina de bollería y panes, lámparas colgantes blancas, techo de placas perforadas y, al fondo, la pared de madera «Saborea la vida… sin prisa» con mesas y vitrina refrigerada vertical

subject_es: Cartel «Horario verano» pegado en la puerta de cristal: en junio, sábados y domingos solo por la mañana

subject_es: Dos tostadas abiertas de salmón ahumado con mayonesa, huevo cocido, tomate, lechugas (escarola, canónigos) y pepinillo, en platos beige lisos sobre superficie gris
subject_en: Two open toasts with smoked salmon, mayonnaise, boiled egg, tomato, salad leaves (frisée, lamb's lettuce) and gherkin, on plain beige plates on a grey surface
notes: No PanPan context: no wooden tray, kraft paper or the café's artisan ceramics; plain beige plates on a flat grey table. Possibly takeaway eaten elsewhere, or another venue. Date 2020-2-20. Compare with p180, a similar salmon toast shot at PanPan.

subject_es: Tostada de salmón ahumado sobre lechugas variadas con pepinillo y crema/mayonesa (pan apenas visible) en plato de cerámica azul estampada, con lata de Fanta Naranja y vaso con hielo en bandeja de madera
subject_en: Smoked-salmon toast over mixed salad leaves with gherkin and cream/mayonnaise (bread barely visible) on a blue patterned ceramic plate, with a Fanta Orange can and a glass of ice on a wooden tray
notes: Fanta can with a prominent logo, which weakens it for the website. PanPan tray, kraft paper and '100% Recycled' napkin. Date 2022-6-4.

subject_es: Porción de coca/bizcocho amarillo con azúcar perlado (probablemente coca de calabaza) en plato oscuro moteado y café con leche con sobre de azúcar PanPan 'Mmmmm!'; al fondo mano sujetando un refresco de cola con limón
subject_en: Slice of yellow coca/sponge cake with pearl sugar (probably pumpkin coca) on a dark speckled plate and a café con leche with a PanPan 'Mmmmm!' sugar sachet; a hand holding a cola with lemon behind
notes: Same scene as p183 (both 2023-1-14); p183 is the cleaner crop without the hand. Brown sachet shows the 'pan pan' wordmark and chevron. Cake identified by resemblance to p182, where the receipt says 'COCA DE CALABAZA'.

subject_es: Porción de coca de calabaza con costra de azúcar en plato turquesa de borde anaranjado y capuchino con cacao, sobre bandeja de madera en mesa oscura, con tique de PanPan
subject_en: Slice of pumpkin coca with a sugar crust on a turquoise orange-rimmed plate and a cocoa-dusted cappuccino, on a wooden tray on a dark table, with a PanPan receipt
text_snippet: PANPAN … COCA DE CALABAZA · CAPUCHINO · Total..
notes: Very wide 4608x2176 panorama-like frame. The receipt names the cake, but prices are cut off/illegible. Cube-tile floor at top-left. Date 2020-3-10.

subject_es: Porción de coca/bizcocho amarillo con azúcar perlado (probablemente coca de calabaza) en plato oscuro moteado y café con leche en taza blanca con sobre de azúcar PanPan 'Mmmmm!', sobre bandeja de madera
subject_en: Slice of yellow coca/sponge cake with pearl sugar (probably pumpkin coca) on a dark speckled plate and a café con leche in a white cup with a PanPan 'Mmmmm!' sugar sachet, on a wooden tray
notes: Same scene as p181, without the hand: cleaner and usable. Brown PanPan sachet with the 'pan pan' wordmark and chevron. Slightly flat indoor light. Date 2023-1-14.

subject_es: Postre de chocolate en forma de tulipa (láminas de chocolate envolviendo el relleno, espolvoreado con cacao; interior no visible) sobre base oscura en plato blanco, con café solo en taza Lavazza y sobre de azúcar PanPan
subject_en: Chocolate tulip dessert (chocolate sheets wrapped around a filling, cocoa-dusted; interior not visible) on a dark base on a white plate, with an espresso in a Lavazza cup and a PanPan sugar sachet
notes: White sugar sachet with a small PanPan chevron and 'pan pan' ('AZÚCAR BLANCO 7 G'). Lavazza logo on the cup. Another tray in the background; sunglasses at the left edge. Date 2023-3-19.

subject_es: Ensalada de pasta tricolor (fusilli) con dados de salmón, aceitunas negras, canónigos y dados blancos (probablemente queso) en bol, con una empanadilla dorada desenfocada sostenida en primer plano
subject_en: Tricolour fusilli pasta salad with salmon cubes, black olives, lamb's lettuce and white cubes (probably cheese) in a bowl, with a blurred golden empanadilla held in the foreground
notes: The foreground empanadilla is out of focus and covers half the salad. A guest in a black puffer jacket (no face) and a dark glass bottle are in the background. Date 2023-3-3.

subject_es: Tostada de pan rústico de miga alveolada en plato craquelado, tomate rallado en cuenco con cuchara, monodosis de aceite de oliva, sobre de sal yodada y café en taza blanca, sobre bandeja de madera en mesa blanca
subject_en: Toasted rustic open-crumb bread on a crackle-glaze plate, grated tomato in a ramekin with a spoon, an olive-oil single-serve pack, an iodised salt sachet and coffee in a white cup, on a wooden tray on a white table
notes: Classic pan con tomate breakfast. 'Mmmm' PanPan sugar sachet (wordmark not visible) and 'Sal Yodada' sachet. A plastic lid sits at top-left and the napkin is stained. Date 2022-8-17.

subject_es: Napolitana de hojaldre dorada (relleno no visible) en plato de cerámica, con una segunda napolitana y tazas Lavazza al fondo sobre bandejas de madera
subject_en: Golden puff-pastry napolitana (filling not visible) on a ceramic plate, with a second napolitana and Lavazza cups behind on wooden trays
notes: Low resolution (original 1150x913) with a soft, filtered look. A companion in a polka-dot top (face cropped out) and an ethnic-pattern cushion are in the background. Lavazza cup logo. Date 2021-7-23.

subject_es: Porción de coca de calabaza (aparente) y cruasán espolvoreado con azúcar glas en plato turquesa, café con leche en vaso y sobre de leche condensada; al fondo taza verde y porción de tarta de superficie tostada (posiblemente de queso)
subject_en: Slice of (apparent) pumpkin coca and an icing-sugar-dusted croissant on a turquoise plate, café con leche in a glass and a condensed-milk sachet; a green mug and a slice of tart with a browned top (possibly cheesecake) behind
notes: Used napkin printed with a brown logo that is not the PanPan chevron (napkin supplier?). The rest of the setting (tray, kraft paper, turquoise plate, textured saucer) matches PanPan. The cake has a bite taken out. A guest's arms in a grey jumper at the top, no face. Date 2019-12-24.

subject_es: Dónut con cobertura de chocolate y perlas crujientes de chocolate negro y blanco en plato de borde azul, con muffin en cápsula de papel detrás; al fondo mano tatuada cogiendo un cruasán y taza de café
subject_en: Chocolate-glazed doughnut topped with dark and white chocolate crispy pearls on a blue-rimmed plate, with a muffin in a paper case behind; a tattooed hand reaching for a croissant and a coffee cup in the background
notes: Sharp, appetising close-up of the doughnut; the background hand could be cropped out. Date 2023-10-30.

subject_es: Porción de tarta de queso horneada con base de galleta, cobertura de mermelada roja y una frambuesa, en plato de borde azul; al fondo taza verde con café con leche y sobre de azúcar 'Mmmmm!'
subject_en: Slice of baked cheesecake on a biscuit base with red jam glaze and a raspberry, on a blue-rimmed plate; a green mug of café con leche and a 'Mmmmm!' sugar sachet behind
notes: Strong dessert candidate: sharp and glossy with shallow depth of field. The PanPan sachet's wordmark is out of focus. Guests at the next table are blurred (a hand, orange juice), no faces. White cross-back chair and cube-tile floor visible. Date 2022-12-3.

subject_es: Dos capuchinos con cacao en tazas blancas sobre bandeja de madera en mesa blanca, con sobres de azúcar PanPan y tique; al fondo mano de clienta con anillo sobre un bolso
subject_en: Two cocoa-dusted cappuccinos in white cups on a wooden tray on a white table, with PanPan sugar sachets and the receipt; a guest's ringed hand resting on a handbag behind
notes: Price source (May 2022): cappuccino 2,00, oat milk at no charge. Sugar sachets show 'Pan pan' and the address. The handbag has a Tommy Hilfiger-style emblem. Cube-tile floor at top-left.

subject_es: Porción de tarta red velvet de dos pisos con frosting de queso crema y roseta de nata, junto a taza verde de leche caliente con sobre de ColaCao, sobre bandeja de madera
subject_en: Two-layer red velvet cake slice with cream-cheese frosting and a piped rosette, beside a green mug of hot milk with a ColaCao sachet, on a wooden tray
text_snippet: ColaCao Original (sachet)
notes: 2019-12-24, older photo. Torso of a seated woman (scarf, green jumper) fills the background, face cropped out. Another person's hand at bottom edge. Prominent third-party ColaCao branding. Cake is appetising, but the background and branding make it hard to publish.

subject_es: Café con leche en taza blanca con dibujo de corazón en la espuma, platillo y cucharilla
subject_en: Café con leche in a white cup with a heart in the milk foam, saucer and teaspoon
notes: 2023-10-30. Close-up, slightly cool/flat light. Wooden trays with kraft paper in the background. Latte art is loose but reads as a heart.

subject_es: Vitrina de bollería: ensaimadas espolvoreadas de azúcar glas, cruasanes de mantequilla sobre pizarra, fuente amarilla con cruasanes espolvoreados de azúcar, bollos azucarados y palmeras de hojaldre
subject_en: Pastry case: icing-sugar-dusted ensaïmadas, butter croissants on a slate, yellow dish of sugar-dusted croissants, sugared buns and puff-pastry palmiers
text_snippet: ENSAIMADA 0,90€; CRUASÁN Mantequilla 1,40€
notes: 2024-02-06. Pine shelves and white labels with the zigzag PanPan pattern on wooden blocks. Filling of the dusted croissants in the yellow dish is not visible (possibly almond, unconfirmed). Good for the bollería section.

subject_es: Vitrina con mini cruasanes de mantequilla, mini cruasanes de almendra, cruasanes de mantequilla, palmeras de hojaldre (una bañada en chocolate) y ensaimadas
subject_en: Pastry case with mini butter croissants, mini almond croissants, butter croissants, puff-pastry palmiers (one chocolate-dipped) and ensaïmadas
text_snippet: mini CROISSANT Mantequilla 0,65€; Mini CRUASÁN ALMENDRA 1,00€; CRUASÁN Mantequilla 1,40€
notes: 2023-08-10. Shot through the glass, reflections at the edges, empty slate in the middle. Prices are legible when zoomed. Same vitrina and labels as p194.

subject_es: Vitrina de empanadillas horneadas (ternera, pollo, espinacas) en filas sobre madera de pino; al fondo cruasanes y napolitanas, arriba porciones de coca/pizza
subject_en: Case of baked empanadillas (beef, chicken, spinach) in rows on pine boards, with croissants and napolitanas behind and coca/pizza slices on the top shelf
text_snippet: EMPANADILLA Ternera 2,20€; EMPANADILLA Pollo 2,20€ (oblique); EMPANADILLA Espinacas 2€
notes: 2024-02-06. Sharp, well lit. The middle 'Pollo 2,20€' label is angled but readable when zoomed. A fourth label bottom right is cut off ('EMPANA... Pi...'). Strong image for the salty-bakery section.

subject_es: Tostada de pan rústico con láminas de aguacate, tomate picado y aros de cebolla, en plato de cerámica estampada
subject_en: Rustic-bread toast with sliced avocado, chopped tomato and onion rings on a patterned ceramic plate
notes: 2023-03-16. Low-angle close-up, appetising. Background has a receipt, a pencil and a cup, so it needs cropping. Dark table.

subject_es: Tostada de pan de masa madre con abanico de aguacate, tomate en dados y cebolla en juliana, en plato rojo moteado con cubiertos
subject_en: Sourdough toast with fanned avocado, diced tomato and sliced onion on a speckled red plate with cutlery
notes: 2023-03-26. Clean, colourful top-three-quarter shot. Same dish as p197 on a different plate. Good avocado-toast candidate.

subject_es: Porción de tarta de queso con cobertura de mermelada de frambuesa y frambuesa, con licuado de fresa y zumo naranja/mango con pajitas de papel
subject_en: Cheesecake slice with raspberry jam topping and a fresh raspberry, with a strawberry smoothie and an orange/mango juice in paper-straw glasses
text_snippet: GC Nature 100% Recycled (napkin)
notes: 2022-02-17. Same scene as p200, shot from above. Cluttered background (phone, other trays, bag). The orange drink's fruit cannot be confirmed (orange or mango).

subject_es: Tarta de queso con mermelada de frambuesa, licuado de fresa y zumo anaranjado con pajitas de papel; al fondo café con leche y licuado verde, pared de pino
subject_en: Raspberry-topped cheesecake, strawberry smoothie and an orange juice with paper straws, with a café con leche and a green smoothie behind against the pine wall
text_snippet: sugar sachet: '...51 · 46005 Valencia · T.963 06 08 11'; napkin 'GC Nature'
notes: 2022-02-17. Same scene as p199 from a better angle, with the untreated pine panels visible. Torsos of other guests at the edges, no faces. Shows the smoothie/licuado range well.

subject_es: Dos capuchinos espolvoreados con cacao, bocadillo de barra con jamón, otro bocadillo (relleno no visible) y cruasán bañado en chocolate con almendra picada
subject_en: Two cocoa-dusted cappuccinos, a baguette sandwich with ham, a second baguette (filling not visible) and a chocolate-dipped croissant topped with chopped almonds
text_snippet: receipt 'PANPAN ... Total 12,15' (upside down)
notes: 2022-06-13. Low resolution (1024x768 original), flat light. Arms of a man in a red T-shirt in the background. Grey floor tiles and white chairs. The receipt text is barely legible.

subject_es: Desayuno visto desde arriba: bandeja con zumo de naranja, capuchino con latte art y cacao, tostada de pan de cereales, mermelada roja y mantequilla; aparte, cruasán mixto de jamón york y queso gratinado
subject_en: Overhead breakfast: tray with orange juice, a latte-art cappuccino dusted with cocoa, multigrain toast, red jam and butter, plus a baked ham-and-cheese croissant on a patterned plate
notes: 2023-10-30. Good flat-lay composition, blue-and-white patterned plates. A seated person's legs (jeans) at the left edge. Cube-pattern floor tiles visible. Receipt corner at bottom right. Could serve as a hero after cropping the left edge.

subject_es: Bandeja de desayuno: zumo de naranja, café con leche en vaso, tostada de barra en plato estampado, mantequilla Président y cuenco de mermelada de melocotón/albaricoque
subject_en: Breakfast tray: orange juice, café con leche in a glass, toasted baguette on a patterned plate, Président butter and a bowl of peach/apricot jam
text_snippet: PRÉSIDENT (butter portion)
notes: 2021-10-17. Tilted, slightly soft, grey cast. Another guest's hand holding a spoon at top left. White wall and taupe chairs. Shows the older Président butter supplier.

subject_es: Terraza: mini cruasanes y cruasán espolvoreado de azúcar en plato rojo; cruasán glaseado, pieza de hojaldre con hilos de chocolate y medio cruasán en plato verde azulado; capuchino
subject_en: Terrace: mini croissants and a sugar-dusted croissant on a red plate; a glazed croissant, a chocolate-drizzled puff-pastry bar and half a croissant on a teal plate; cappuccino
text_snippet: 'Estrella Galicia ... Resiste desde' (table); receipt 'BARRA 09:24'; torn sachet 'pan'
notes: Date 2023-07-18. Outdoor terrace table printed with Estrella Galicia and Xacobeo(?) logos (third-party branding). A torn PanPan sugar sachet ('pan' + zigzag) plus the same trays and plates confirm the venue. Grey overcast light.

subject_es: Detalle del rótulo 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' en letras grises corpóreas sobre paneles de pino, con espigas de trigo secas en vitrina alta
subject_en: Close-up of the 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' slogan in grey 3D letters on pine panels, with dried wheat stalks in a glass box above
text_snippet: Saborea la ... si[n prisa] (cropped)
notes: No date, 1080x1920, probably a video frame. Pixel-identical to p207 (different file hash, JPEG noise only). Slogan cropped. p217 shows the full slogan.

subject_es: Mesa junto al ventanal con barra de pino: capuchino y focaccia rellena de jamón cocido y tomate, sobre de azúcar PanPan; al fondo vitrina y la Gran Vía arbolada al sol
subject_en: Window-counter seat on pine: cappuccino and a focaccia filled with cooked ham and tomato, PanPan sugar sachet, with the pastry case and tree-lined Gran Vía in the sun behind
text_snippet: sachet 'G.V. Marqués del Turia, 51 · 46005 Valencia · T.963 06 08 11 · pan pan · AZÚCAR MORENO 7 Gr.'
notes: No date. Best photo in this batch and a hero candidate: warm low sun, pine counter, window vinyl zigzag, and the brown/rust interior panel with the 'pan pan' 3D logo, zigzag block and 'mmM!' (mirrored from inside). Cup has a geometric rosette logo, brand unidentified. Tiny passers-by outside.

subject_es: Detalle del rótulo 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' en letras grises sobre paneles de pino, con espigas de trigo secas arriba
subject_en: Close-up of the 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' slogan in grey letters on pine panels, with dried wheat stalks above
text_snippet: Saborea la ... si[n prisa] (cropped)

subject_es: Dónut glaseado rosa con perlas de azúcar rojas y blancas, partido y relleno de crema blanca, sostenido en la mano; zumo de naranja detrás
subject_en: Pink-glazed doughnut with red and white sugar pearls, torn open to show a white cream filling, held in hand, with orange juice behind
notes: No date. Pine wall and brown banquette. A child's hand holds it, with another child's arm at left. Same doughnut as p213, likely 'PANUT COLORES 1,40' on receipt p210 (July 2024, same visit probable).

subject_es: Rincón del salón: dos hornacinas de pino retroiluminadas con plantas, libros, reloj de madera y letras 'BOOK', sobre mesas y sillas tapizadas en taupe
subject_en: Dining-room corner: two backlit pine wall niches with plants, books, a wooden clock and 'BOOK' letters, above tables and taupe upholstered chairs
notes: No date. Grey-white wall, mix of dark and white tables, white shell chair in the foreground. Decent atmosphere shot but plain.

subject_es: Ticket de caja de PanPan (Panber Café S.L.) del 19/07/24 con tostada integral, quiche, 'panut', cafés con leche y zumos

text_snippet: TOSTADA INTEGRAL 1,50; QUICHE YORK/QUESO 1,90; PANUT COLORES 1,40; 2 CAFE CON LECHE 1,75 (3,50); 2 ZUMO NARANJA 2,20 (4,40); TOPPING TOMATE 0,50; Total 13,30

Iberitos olive-oil portion and cube floor tiles visible.

subject_es: Salón con cola ante el mostrador, camarero con delantal de rayas, vitrina refrigerada vertical de tartas y vasitos de postre, suelo de baldosa hidráulica de cubos y ventanal a la Gran Vía
subject_en: Café floor with a queue at the counter, a server in a striped apron, an upright chilled cake and dessert-cup cabinet, cube-pattern tiles and the window onto Gran Vía
text_snippet: wifi sign 'Repeti...' (cut off)
notes: No date (summer). Many identifiable customers: a seated woman with glasses and queueing women in profile. Staff member shown mostly from behind. Useful for showing the cake cabinet, pendant lamps, perforated ceiling and tiles, but not publishable without blurring.

subject_es: Café con leche en taza blanca con espuma, cucharilla y platillo; detrás otra taza Lavazza, vaso de agua con hielo y monodosis de aceite
subject_en: Café con leche with foam in a white cup, spoon and saucer, with a Lavazza cup, a glass of iced water and an olive-oil portion behind
text_snippet: LAVAZZA (cup); Iberitos Aceite
notes: No date, same visit as p210/p216 likely. Cup with Lavazza logo (coffee supplier branding). Weak latte art, harsh overhead light.

subject_es: Dónut glaseado rosa con perlas de azúcar rojas y blancas en plato de cerámica de estrellas, sobre bandeja de madera con cuchillo
subject_en: Pink-glazed doughnut with red and white sugar pearls on a star-patterned ceramic plate, on a wooden tray with a knife
notes: No date. Same doughnut as p208, probably the 'Panut colores' (1,40 € on receipt p210). Clean, soft background. White lace clothing at bottom left, which needs a crop.

subject_es: Zumo de naranja natural en vaso con pajita de papel sobre bandeja; al fondo quiche individual gratinada en plato de borde azul
subject_en: Fresh orange juice in a glass with a paper straw on a tray, with an individual golden-baked quiche on a blue-rimmed plate behind
notes: No date. Quiche filling not visible; receipt p210 lists 'QUICHE YORK/QUESO 1,90' from probably the same visit. Arm of a person at top right edge. Knife smeared with juice.

subject_es: Zumo de naranja con pajita de papel y quiche individual gratinada en plato de borde azul, sobre bandeja de madera
subject_en: Orange juice with a paper straw and an individual golden-baked quiche on a blue-rimmed plate, on a wooden tray
notes: No date. Same scene as p214 from above. A child's arm and white eyelet top on the right, torn straw wrapper in the foreground. Quiche filling not visible.

subject_es: Tostada de barra con costra de sésamo y amapola, con aceite de oliva, tomate triturado aparte en cuenco y monodosis de aceite

text_snippet: Iberitos Aceite; order slip 'ESTHER BARRA'
notes: No date. Classic 'pan con tomate' breakfast, sharp and appetising. The order slip shows what may be a staff name ('ESTHER'), so crop it. Likely the 'TOSTADA INTEGRAL + TOPPING TOMATE' from receipt p210.

subject_es: Pared de paneles de pino con el lema 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' en letras grises corpóreas, espigas de trigo en vitrina alta y banco corrido tapizado en marrón
subject_en: Pine-panelled wall with the slogan 'Saborea la vida… sin prisa' in grey 3D letters, dried wheat in a high glass box and a brown upholstered banquette
text_snippet: Saborea la vida... sin prisa
notes: No date. Full-slogan version of p205/p207. Low angle from table level, empty room, a garment left on the banquette. Good brand/atmosphere image, and the slogan works as site copy.
